content.tagline: Natural-source PDRN (Sodium DNA) cosmetic raw material
content.descriptor: Weiyi Biotech (为邑生物) — a manufacturer of natural-source PDRN raw material (Sodium DNA) for cosmetic formulation, offered in grades of 99% or higher with product documents, batch certificates of analysis and evaluation samples.
about: Weiyi Biotech manufactures PDRN raw materials. Its natural-source PDRN is produced from male salmon testes through extraction, separation, purification and drying, and is identified in its cosmetic raw-material documentation as Sodium DNA. The company offers grades of 99% or higher, reports endotoxin below 0.01 EU/mg, and provides product documents, applicable batch certificates of analysis and evaluation samples.

Teranova presents Weiyi Biotech (为邑生物) to cosmetic brands, formulators and contract manufacturers. Product documents and evaluation samples are requested through Teranova; prices and commercial terms are shared on request and are not published.
facts: Manufacturer of natural-source PDRN raw material; cosmetic raw-material name: Sodium DNA
Starting material: male salmon testes; process: extraction, separation, purification and drying
Grades of 99% or higher; assay method and calculation basis as stated in the applicable product documents
Endotoxin below 0.01 EU/mg, as reported by the company

No exclusive distributor — open to regional distributors through Teranova
channels: Brands developing repair-oriented, anti-aging and brightening skincare

lines.name: Helio PDRN — Sodium DNA
lines.note: Natural-source PDRN produced from male salmon testes through extraction, separation, purification and drying. A water-soluble powder offered in grades of 99% or higher, with the applicable batch certificate of analysis.

tech.name: From salmon testes to Sodium DNA
tech.note: The company's natural-source PDRN is produced from male salmon testes through extraction, separation, purification and drying. In its cosmetic raw-material documentation the material is identified as Sodium DNA.

tech.name: Purity grade and endotoxin
tech.note: The company offers grades of 99% or higher. The assay method and calculation basis for the purity grade are those given in the applicable product documents and batch certificate of analysis. The company reports endotoxin below 0.01 EU/mg, which corresponds to below 0.01 EU/mL in a 1 mg/mL test solution.

tech.name: Product comparison, in the manufacturer's words
tech.note: Weiyi Biotech states that its quotation is the lowest for comparable PDRN grades of 99% or higher and that its endotoxin level is the lowest in the industry, with a reported result below 0.01 EU/mg. Specific quotations are not published.

tech.name: Specification summary
tech.note: According to the company's Technical Data Sheet: white, white-like or light yellow powder, soluble in water; pH 5.0–9.0 in a 1% aqueous solution; limits for lead, cadmium, arsenic and mercury, total aerobic count, yeast and mould, and pathogen absence (thermotolerant coliforms, Staphylococcus aureus, Pseudomonas aeruginosa). Recommended use level 0.01–2.0%; shelf life 24 months. Batch values are given in the applicable certificate of analysis.

formats: Evaluation samples and bulk supply; quantities on request
content.exportNote: Cooperation through Teranova is offered on FOB Hong Kong, CIF and DDP terms. There is no exclusive distributor, and the company is open to regional distributors through Teranova. Prices and payment terms are not published and are shared with partners on request.
